# FlowFindingKind { #timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind }

```python
core.FlowFindingKind()
```

What playing flow control found.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ambiguous_targets](#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind.ambiguous_targets) | Two destinations of one Jump, of the same kind, held at once. |
| [endless_loop](#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind.endless_loop) | A Jump was taken in a state the flow had been in before. |
| [flow_ends_at_break](#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind.flow_ends_at_break) | The flow ended at a Break that states no condition, before the end. |
| [never_played](#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind.never_played) | A stretch of the axis lies in no run. |
| [undetermined_target](#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind.undetermined_target) | A destination nobody can check was passed and not taken. |
